Original synthetic fixtures generated for StudyStream tests: an 8-second PCM WAV tone and a three-page, searchable PDF. No user media is included.

`motion.mp4` is the original MyVLC synthetic 640×360 H.264 moving-circle fixture.
It contains generated artwork and text, no personal media. Regenerate with
`scripts/generate-video-fixture.swift`. `scripts/verify-tangerine-native.py`
embeds it only into the native integration test using a temporary compile-time
define; it is not a production application asset.
